new_findings_from_audit.description: OpenLID misclassifies handwritten and mixed-language documents. test_ori_00045 classified as Assamese/Bengali (0.767 conf) when actually English+Chinese.
new_findings_from_audit.recommendation: Add OpenLID confidence threshold (reject <0.5), cross-validate with LLM enrichment for handwritten content

new_findings_from_audit.description: 22% of audit samples (8/36) are rotated 90 degrees clockwise. This is higher than expected and affects OCR/downstream.
new_findings_from_audit.recommendation: Orientation detection is critical. LLM enrichment captures this for ori/ images. Need automated detection for res/ images.

new_findings_from_audit.description: Some ori/ images show UI toolbars (screen capture) or AI chatbot output (CopyEdit labels), suggesting capture methods beyond camera_smartphone.
new_findings_from_audit.recommendation: Consider screen_capture and ai_generated as additional capture_method values

new_findings_from_audit.description: 5/36 audit samples (14%) have mixed English+Chinese content. Current schema supports single iso639_language, losing mixed-language information.
new_findings_from_audit.recommendation: Consider adding secondary_language field or using BCP47 language tags that support multiple languages
